425460.overview: A two-player only artillery duel by Martin Piper for the 2022 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

425499.overview:
A Galaxian-style shooter, utilising a cross-platform game engine.

Guntus puts you in control of a mighty spaceship that must destroy waves of enemy formations that are out to destroy you. The more waves of enemies you destroy the higher your score. Just beware that through every stage the enemy waves become ever more dangerous and so does the level of difficulty. So good luck and let us know how far you get in Inufuto's new game of Guntus!

425502.overview: The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is an award-winning interactive horror from Stefan Vogt, the acclaimed author of Hibernated and The Curse of Rabenstein. Take on the role of novelist Thomas King and his wife Cora as they move into a remote Scottish manor house, just days before Christmas 1986. Seeking inspiration for his next book, Thomas begins to explore the history of Blackwood Manor, only to uncover a dark secret that dates back centuries to the days of the Great Scottish Witch Hunts. The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is a complex interactive fiction piece written in Infocom's advanced Z-machine format XZIP. The game has three different endings, a bad, a neutral and a good ending, depending on the player's choices. It is very likely that the player, on a first playthrough, will not reach the good ending, even though it is possible. Reaching the bad or neutral ending first is part of the experience and helps the player understanding the true intentions of some of the NPCs and the impact of decisions made, so they may be reconsidered.

443949.overview:
Help Sir Darren in his quest to rescue the fair princess from Embers the dragon.

The great green dragon Embers has kidnapped the princess, and the king is most upset with the situation. He has called upon Sir Darren of Durham, also known as the Good Kniight to set forth and rescue his daughter.

With a stomach full of Marmite on crumpets and 2 cups of tea, Sir Darren sets out on this grand and blummin' scary adventure.

Move Sir Darren from the left to the right of each screen.

Dodge fireballs, arrows, dragons, enemy soldiers, spikes and many other obstacles as you go.

Use ropes and moving platforms to aid you in your valiant quest to rescue the fair princess from the clutches of the evil dragon.

444012.overview:
You play the part of a trainee paramedic driver on your journey to become fully qualified. To achieve this you must survive 8 full days on the job in order to reach your qualification ceremony on day 9. Each day is split up in 10 emergency calls which you must attend within a set limit. Allow that time to expire, and so will the poor patient. So, why are these calls so difficult and time consuming to attend? Well, due to the busiest week that "Killum Hall Hospital" has ever seen, cars and trucks have filled the ambulance bays making a swift exit almost impossible.

It may seem easy at first but don't be deceived, the hospital is getting busier by the day making your task even harder. All the while those emergency calls are coming in thick and fast.

ARE YOU UP TO THE JOB?

FEATURES:
The game takes the format of a sliding puzzle. The play area consisting of a top-down view of the hospital car park/parking lot, and an exit road. The object of each call is to get your ambulance to the exit road by moving all the vehicles vertically or horizontally around the play area. If you succeed within the time limit then the game will proceed on to the next call.

447973.overview: The game was released for commodore 64 in 1984 by Activision. It has a feature that sets it apart from other video games at the time. When the game is successfully completed it generates an account number, allowing you to use the money you earned next time you play the game. In an era where the credit card was not yet invented, i found that idea ingenious. On this cartridge you’ll find a custom made title screen and illustrated instructions, explaining the basics of the game. It also contains an account generator, allowing you to make your own Ghostbusters accounts with a name and a balance of your choice. Last but not least, it of cause includes a flawless and fast loading copy of the game. I hope you enjoy this cartridge as much as i have enjoyed making it.

448591.overview:
Cops and Robbers is a two-player game originally published in "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games." One player controls the cops, while the other controls the robbers. The goal for the cops is to chase and catch the robbers in the city before they escape to their hideout.

The city streets run north to south and east to west. The cops have faster cars but must obey traffic laws, allowing only forward or left turns at intersections, with no right turns or U-turns. The robbers can ignore traffic laws, giving them better maneuverability despite having slower cars.

Players can choose the speed of the game. At its fastest, it becomes a thrilling chase through the streets. Played more slowly, it becomes a game of strategy.

452664.overview:
An Italian language collect'em-up created in 1984. Romeo , the protagonist of our game, is the victim of a spell cast on him by the old witch of the woods, since some time ago he had collected magical seedlings destined for mysterious spells. To free himself from the spell that oppresses him, Romeo must go through eight enchanted gardens that separate him from the wall beyond which he will find salvation. 
 
During this adventurous and dangerous journey he must collect all the lucky charm plants he encounters in his steps, while avoiding the poisonous ones planted by the witch in his path. But his escape is also hampered by horrendous monsters who relentlessly pursue him, and if that weren’t enough he must avoid falling into the many bewitched wells.

However, there is a twist, it's played from a fixed screen position, just like in Galaxian, hence the game's name.

The player's ship is also from Galaxian.

The score decreases over time.

The game was developed by Arlasoft, and published by Zzap! 64 in 2023.

455861.overview:
You are a warrior on a heroic quest to save the prince or princess. On your journey to the dungeon where they are held there are magic rings, swords, and wizards to help you, but the forest also contains some bad creatures and a few surprises. Your decisions influence the outcome of the game.

You could be lucky and rescue the prince or princess, or you might be eaten by a hungry dragon!   Every game is played differently, as it randomly generated each time it is run.

Objective:
To reach the dungeon and save your prince or princess, you need at least 15 victories, 75 luck points, and the enchanted sword. It also helps if you avoid any curses, which reduce your luck on each turn. However, finding the magic ring adds points to your luck score. Don't run out of food either, since you could starve to death, but  you can restock by visiting the market. 

Hint:
As you progress through the forest you will encounter a number of obstacles including a river, lake or mountain that will force you to make a decision.  It pays to learn by your mistakes and for you to remember where different decisions may lead you, and select the most suitable outcome with the best odds.

463682.overview:
A life simulation game published in the Italian book "20 Programmi per Commodore 64". 
 
Come to know the harsh rules of survival. We know, in fact, that too few "individuals" lead to a species' extinction due to reproductive difficulties, while too many trigger natural selection—eliminating the weakest individuals, for instance, because there isn't enough food for everyone. There is, however, a point of equilibrium that allows a relatively stable number of individuals to survive and reproduce. Our program will simulate this simple natural law by representing a "territory" on the screen (imagine, for example, the hunting grounds of a prehistoric tribe) and allowing the player to place a certain number of stars within it (representing the inhabitants): depending on the number of stars placed, the system will identify a state of overpopulation, under-population, or equilibrium based on established parameters. Starting from the player's initial configuration, the program will calculate a second "generation" of stars (i.e., the number of individuals remaining in the territory after one generation, according to the law of survival) and all subsequent generations, until a command is issued to stop execution. Since the population a territory can sustain varies according to social and technological conditions, the reader can modify the size of the territory and the parameters determining the birth and death rates of the stars (representing the individuals) by making very simple changes to a few lines of the program.

472882.overview: A classic shooting game in which the player destroys aerial and ground targets. Whilst in flight, it’s worth catching the flashing objects, which award 2,500 points. 474581.overview: In Gravity Snake, you control a snake trapped inside a series of mind-bending puzzle chambers. Collect every fruit, avoid letal traps or getting stuck, and find your way to the exit. Gravity constantly influences your movement, turning every level into a challenge of logic, timing, and careful planning.

476093.overview: Once the game begins, you need to search for the 3 green ghosts and capture them. To do this you need to reduce their health using the proton pack. The ghosts health will be reduced only if the ghost touches the end of the stream. Once the ghosts energy has been reduced noted by the ghosts mouth being open and speed reduction.  You can throw the trap using the 'T' key but only when the ghost energy has been reduced. For bonus's points you may see black ghosts floating around that you can kill. To top up your energy grab yourself a Twinkie.
